description: Predict Android malware vs goodware from permission and API-call binary features in TUNADROMD. Binary target Label is numeric in the source data. Profile: 4464 rows, 241 sparse binary permission/API indicators, no observed missing values, 42 constant-zero features, imbalanced target (3565 / 899).

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution, and basic data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking and handling missing values if present.
Plan recognizes numeric-coded categorical/ordinal/binary features and avoids treating all columns as arbitrary continuous variables.
Plan includes checking class balance and using an imbalance-aware validation/modeling strategy when needed.
Plan includes checking constant or low-variance features and dropping/ignoring them when useful.
Plan uses the task metric and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for the dataset size and tabular feature mix.

metadata.bench_preprocessing: Dropped one row with an empty target value and kept the source numeric Label target.
